newsitem.title: UK: London silver fixed at lowest since March 7, 1995.
newsitem.headline: London silver fixed at lowest since March 7, 1995.

text.p: Silver fixed at 454.75 cents per ounce on Friday, its lowest fixing in over 2-1/4 years.
At its previous fix on Thursday the metal was valued at 465.40 cents.
Dealers said the silver price slipped when heavy spcaultive selling sent gold prices falling to their lowest levels in nearly 12 years on Thursday.
The collapse in gold followed an announcement by the Reserve Bank of Australia that it has sold 167 tonnes of gold from its reserves which it saw as surplus to its needs.
"Silver has been uncertain after repeatedly failing to hold gains recently. The fall in gold was the last straw for it," a dealer said.
But silver still had the better chance of recovery compared to the fundamentally weaker gold market, he added.
